info.title: AI Trust ID selected-text JSON API
info.description: Open-source engineering preview for explicitly selected text, with public reachability and host-specific installation verified separately on the connection page. This manifest adds no endpoint and grants no AI-host approval. Ordinary JSON calls only; MCP is separate. No account or authorization token is required or accepted. Selected text reaches the operator server; application input storage and automatic research collection are disabled. Do not send secrets. No safety, truth, AI-origin, certification or independent accuracy claim.

servers.description: Engineering preview; public reachability and host account installation are verified separately. See the connection page for current status. No availability or host approval is asserted by this manifest.

post.description: Engineering preview for supported command-risk patterns only. Text reaches this server; no application input storage or automatic research upload. PS is not independently validated. PII_REDACTED may be requested but is always Unavailable remotely. HTTP 200 may be COMPLETE, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE; NO_FINDING is not safe.

200.description: JSON result. Inspect its state; HTTP success is not safety or validation approval.

400.description: Request refused: malformed or duplicate-key JSON, unsupported fields/type/text, query, credentials, compression, framing or Origin at the proxy. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

403.description: Host or application Origin refused. No browser CORS grant is provided. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

404.description: Unknown path or unsupported method at the public proxy. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

405.description: Unsupported method when talking directly to the application; public proxy may instead return 404. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

413.description: Body exceeds the 256000-byte wire limit. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

421.description: TLS server-name and HTTP Host mismatch refused by the proxy. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

429.description: Finite shared rate limit reached. Retry deliberately; no request-identity tracking. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

503.description: Busy admission or service unavailable; no valid check completed. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

504.description: Request or upstream deadline expired; no valid check completed. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text from the proxy or JSON from the application; do not parse them as successful checks.

502.description: Reverse proxy cannot obtain an upstream response. No valid check completed. Refusal bodies can be fixed plain text rather than application JSON.

requestBody.description: Send only text deliberately chosen for disclosure. Nonempty after Unicode whitespace stripping; at most 20000 Unicode code points and 80000 UTF-8 bytes. Unpaired surrogates refuse. JSON body at most 256000 bytes; duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, depth above 20, extra fields and duplicate tags refuse. Use application/json without compression, credentials or URL/query content. Code enforces these wire constraints beyond object-schema validation.
